youtube_description:
If you were able to successfully navigate a sophisticated Google Search, you can do the same with Generative AI.

I have a 15 minute video sharing my exact process for using ChatGPT - NOT a list of static AI prompts like some guru. You can opt in, and watch this process, and use it to successfully navigate a sophisticated AI prompt process of your own for any purpose, or piece of content.

BTW... I also hate the name ChatGPT - that name was obviously created by devs, not marketers. So, I created a new name for my AI Chatbot Assistant, and I share it in the 15 minute video. If you opt in and watch it, please let me know what you think about this new name! I'm hoping it catches on. 😉

https://callmemkj.com/aiprompt to opt in, and watch if you're game. 😁
